YOUR WORKING DIRECTORY IS `/opt/nxeon-agent-apps` — a dedicated git worktree (branch agent/apps) of the Nxeon hosting platform. Do ALL work there: read, edit, and commit only under /opt/nxeon-agent-apps. NEVER touch /opt/nxeon (live production) or the other /opt/nxeon-* worktrees. `cd /opt/nxeon-agent-apps` first. node_modules is symlinked in, so `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` works.

# TASK: Fix the broken shared-hosting "Apps" tab and redesign it from a dropdown to a grid of app logos.

## The bug (live, customer-facing)
On a shared-hosting account, the **Apps** tab shows "One-click apps" with an "Install app" `<select>` dropdown ("choose…"). When the user picks an option, the page just refreshes and NOTHING happens — no install, no feedback.

## Files
- `components/customer/hosting/AppInstaller.tsx` — the panel UI (the dropdown).
- `lib/actions-hosting.ts`: `installApp(accountId, slug)` (~line 946), `installWordPress(accountId)` (~line 918), `listAppCatalog()` (~line 940), `queueHostingAppInstall(accountId, slug, maxDatabases, email)` (~line 518).
- `components/customer/hosting/HostingTabs.tsx` — how the Apps tab is mounted.
- `components/ui/AppLogo.tsx`, `components/marketing/GameLogo.tsx` — logo-component conventions to mirror.
- `components/customer/DeployWizard.tsx` — the VPS wizard renders OS choices as clickable logo tiles with a selected state; use it as the visual reference.

## Do
1. **Diagnose why selecting does nothing** (refresh + no effect). Read installApp/installWordPress/queueHostingAppInstall. Likely: the select submits a server action whose result/error is never surfaced, or it silently no-ops (needs a DB first / env-gated / swallowed error). Fix so the install is actually enqueued AND the user gets clear feedback: an "installing…"/pending state, a success confirmation (show resulting site/admin URL when available), and a visible error on failure. Shared-hosting provisioning may run in SANDBOX mode in non-prod — ensure queued/active state still displays.
2. **Redesign** the dropdown into a responsive **grid of app logo tiles** (like the deploy wizard OS tiles): each app = clickable card with logo + name + one-line description; selecting shows an Install action. On-brand (navy/violet/cyan). Reuse AppLogo/GameLogo; add tasteful inline-SVG or lettermark fallbacks for any missing logo, following the existing drop-in convention. Feature WordPress prominently plus everything `listAppCatalog()` returns.
3. Preserve all guards (DB caps, ownership, cross-tenant). Don't weaken security.

## Deliverable
`npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` must be clean for your changes. Commit to the agent/apps branch (clear message). Do NOT push to origin, do NOT promote. Final report: root cause of the bug, files changed, how the new UI works, any logo assets added, and any edits to shared files (esp. lib/actions-hosting.ts) I need for integration.

I'm seeing the flow now—when a user selects an app, the `pick` function triggers either `installApp` or `installWordPress`, which enqueues a hosting task on the server and returns success, then the page reloads. The issue is that after the reload, nothing appears to happen visually, even though the task was queued.

The real problem is likely a lack of feedback surface. The Apps tab only shows the dropdown; there's no list of installed or queued apps displayed anywhere, so from the user's perspective the page just refreshes and looks identical. There's also a possibility that if the account is in SANDBOX provisioning mode rather than ACTIVE, the task gets queued but never actually processes, making it seem like nothing occurred at all.…

content.text:
Done. Committed to `agent/apps` (commit `9acc6f8`), typecheck clean, nothing pushed or promoted.

## Root cause of the bug

The install was **actually being enqueued correctly** — `installApp`/`installWordPress` create a `hostingTask` and return `{ ok: true }`. The bug was purely a missing-feedback problem in the UI:

- `components/customer/hosting/AppInstaller.tsx` was a bare `<select>` whose `onChange` handler, on success, just called `window.location.reload()`. The dropdown is uncontrolled (`defaultValue=""`), so after the reload it reset to "choose…".
- The Apps tab renders **only** that dropdown. The queued task and its progress/credentials are surfaced in the **Overview** tab (`TaskFeed` + `AppCredentials`), never in the Apps tab.
- Net effect for a customer standing on the Apps tab: pick an app → page refreshes → identical dropdown → "nothing happened," even though the worker was installing in the background. Errors were only shown via a browser `alert()`, and a SANDBOX/non-prod account that leaves the task `PENDING` had no queued-state display anywhere near the picker.

## Files changed

- `components/customer/hosting/AppInstaller.tsx` — full rewrite (dropdown → grid + feedback).
- `lib/actions-hosting.ts` — added one server action (see integration note below).

## How the new UI works

- Responsive grid of clickable app **logo tiles** (`sm:2 / lg:3` cols), styled to match the deploy wizard's OS/app tiles (`card`, `!border-brand-400 ring-1 ring-brand-400` selected state, navy/violet/cyan). WordPress is first with a "Recommended" ribbon; every `hostingAppMenu()` entry follows, each with logo + name + a one-line blurb + a `database`/`no DB` chip.
- Selecting a tile reveals an on-brand action bar with an **Install <name>** button. Clicking it calls the same `installWordPress`/`installApp` actions and drives real state: an "Installing…" button state, an inline green success notice, and inline red errors (no more `alert()` / no more blind `reload()`).
- A live **"Installations"** section polls `listHostingTasks(accountId)` every 5s (filtered to `WORDPRESS_INSTALL`/`APP_INSTALL`), so queued/running/done status shows right in the Apps tab — including a SANDBOX `PENDING` task. On completion it shows the WordPress login URL + admin user/password (mirroring the Overview `TaskFeed`), or the catalog app's finish-the-web-installer note.
- Logo resolution: prefers the Simple Icons brand-glyph path (rendered inline on a light chip), falling back to the shared `AppLogo` (bundled `/public/logos` SVG or a lettermark) — no blank tiles. **No new logo asset files were added**; existing `/public/logos/*.svg` plus the server-resolved `simple-icons` paths cover everything.

## Edit to shared file you need for integration (`lib/actions-hosting.ts`)

Added one server action:

```ts
export async function listHostingAppMenu(): Promise<HostingAppMenuItem[]>
```

It's `requireUser()`-gated and returns `hostingAppMenu()` (WordPress-first, enriched with blurbs + Simple Icons SVG paths). `simple-icons` stays server-side; only the extracted path/hex strings cross to the client. It imports `hostingAppMenu`/`HostingAppMenuItem` from `./hosting-app-menu` (added to the import block). The old `listAppCatalog()` is untouched and still exported.

## Security

Unchanged. All guards remain in `installApp`/`installWordPress` — `ownedActiveAccount` (ownership + ACTIVE gate), DB-cap checks (`maxDatabases`), and cross-tenant `Forbidden`. `listHostingTasks` already enforces ownership + `assertNotImpersonating`. The new `listHostingAppMenu` only reads a static catalog behind `requireUser()`. No guard was weakened.
